quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech IR presentation: YTD September 2026 sales with appendix (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 sales presentation appendix, development pipeline as of October 22, 2026: Phase I 33 NMEs + 6 AIs, Phase II 11 NMEs + 5 AIs, Phase III 13 NMEs + 22 AIs and registration (US & EU) 3 NMEs + 8 AIs. Trial status updates: Vabysmo POYANG (myopic CNV) met its primary endpoint in Q3 2026 and was filed in China in October 2026; enicepatide Ph II in obesity with T2D and tifeglipron Ph II in obesity met their primary endpoints in Q3 2026; recruitment completed in Q3 2026 for giredestrant pionERA (N=1,050), trontinemab TRONTIER 1 and 2 (N=1101 and N=1060) and afimkibart AMETRINE-2; first patients in Q3 2026 for Ocrevus OCTAVIBE, dirloctocogene samoparvovec Ph IIb and petrelintide ZUPREME-3 and -5, and in October 2026 for divarasib KRASCENDO 3, trontinemab PrevenTRON (N=1600) and petrelintide ZUPREME-4. Enspryng SatraGO-1 did not meet its primary endpoint but showed a positive numerical trend, while SatraGO-2 met it; the Hemlibra autoinjector has potential to launch YE 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: pipeline Ph III 13 NMEs + 22 AIs; POYANG filed in China October 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech IR presentation: YTD September 2026 sales with appendix (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 sales presentation appendix, sales detail: products launched since 2015 reached CHF 22,645 million YTD (+12% CER; US CHF 11,450 million +8%, Japan +30%, International +26%); Q3 CER growth by quarter: Pharma Division +8% (US +5%, Europe +2%, Japan +49%, International +11%), Diagnostics +5% and Roche Group +7%; Q3 Diagnostics sales CHF 3,546 million (+5%). Diagnostics YTD: North America +9% (US +8%), Asia-Pacific -4% with China -13%; Core Lab immunodiagnostics +4% and clinical chemistry +9%, Pathology Lab companion diagnostics +21%, transplant +17%, Liat POC MDx -21%. Product commentary: Ocrevus is #1 in the US for both dynamic and total patient share; Vabysmo has double-digit market share in Japan and strong uptake in China post NRDL; Actemra and Herceptin declining on biosimilars; Kadcyla impacted by competition in metastatic BC.
quarterly_data.figure: products launched since 2015 CHF 22,645 million (+12%); Q3 Pharma +8%, Diagnostics +5%; China Diagnostics -13%
